name: Vitality adds 10% Stamina to Eternal Curse (#1162)
contract: Vitality 704166 is one effect: aura 107 with MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, which Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers maps to effect index 0) and BasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = +10, over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 32) = word 2 bit 5 = Eternal Curse 800157 and Hemal Excision 803681. Eternal Curse's effect 0 is aura 137 MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE with MiscValue 2 (STAT_STAMINA) and value 25, so it becomes 35. Eternal Curse's AttributesEx3 is 0x100000 (SPELL_ATTR3_ALLOW_AURA_WHILE_DEAD), not 0x20000000 (SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS), so caster modifiers are not blocked. Tooltip: "Increases your Stamina while in Eternal Curse by an additional $s1%." Regression guard for native behaviour.

steps.label: Eternal Curse grants its authored 25% Stamina before the talent
Vitality raises Eternal Curse's Stamina effect to 35%
